viewers_files_fallback_binary: Heading of the card shown instead of the editor when a file is not text.
viewers_files_fallback_binary_detail: Line under the heading of the binary card. {size} is the file size already formatted (3.9 KB), kept as is.
viewers_files_fallback_first_bytes: Label above the hex dump of the first bytes of a large or binary file. {size} is the size of the excerpt already formatted (3.9 KB), kept as is.
viewers_files_fallback_large_detail: Line under the heading of the too-large card. {size} is the file size already formatted (3.9 KB), kept as is.
viewers_files_fallback_too_large: Heading of the card shown instead of the editor when a file is larger than the editor opens (32 MB).
viewers_files_viewer_actions_open_extern: Button label in a <button> element, in ViewerActions (apps/desktop/src/lib/viewers/ViewerActions.svelte). Extracted by i18n:extract: refine this description on review.
